title: Grateful Dead Live at Hollywood Palladium on 1972-09-09
lineage: MAR > R; sony ecm 22p's > sony tc-770; taped by Bruce Harvie; transfer: tdk 1800-sd 7" reel @ 3.75 ips, dolby b: technics rs-1506 > teac an-180 > benchmark adc1 24/96 > tascam hd-p2, adobe audition cs6 > cd wave > flac; transfer & seeded by Rob Berger
source: updated source info: aud 1st gen reel; Rob Bertrando's copy (via Michael Johan);

ai_review.summary: Beautiful, immersive sound captures a high‑energy September 1972 vibe
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about the crystal‑clear audio, saying it makes you feel like you're right there at the show. The performance is described as having the energy of a classic September 1972 concert, making this recording a standout listening experience despite the lack of specific song highlights.

ai_rating.rationale: Two consistent 5‑star reviews praise both the audio fidelity and the show's energy, indicating an excellent recording of a high‑quality performance.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the sound as beautiful, crystal‑clear and immersive, with no reported flaws or mix issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Energetic performance reminiscent of September 1972 shows, suggesting strong pacing and momentum throughout.
